LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Today-timeline view of events for a sidebar column. Auto-trims empty hours, handles overlapping events side-by-side, live now-line, in-N-min badge, Join button for common web-meeting URLs, and a short Upcoming list.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: Two-letter code - 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls all built-in UI strings (headings, buttons, badges). Explicit values set on cardTitle / emptyStateMessage still override the dictionary.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default (‘My Day’ / ‘Ma journée’).

property.name: startHour
property.label: Start hour (0-23)
property.description: Earliest hour shown when auto-trim is off or when auto-trim can't narrow further.

property.name: endHour
property.label: End hour (0-23)
property.description: Latest hour shown (same rule as start hour).

property.name: disableAutoTrim
property.label: Disable auto-trim
property.description: Auto-trim is ON by default - the timeline is bounded to [first event − padding, last event + padding] (clamped between Start and End hour). Turn this on to always render the full Start→End hour window.

property.name: autoTrimPaddingMin
property.label: Auto-trim padding (minutes)
property.description: Empty-hour margin kept before the first event and after the last event when auto-trim is on. Set to 0 to crop exactly to the events.

property.name: daysAhead
property.label: Days ahead to query
property.description: Today counts as 1. Used to populate the Upcoming list.

property.name: typeColorsCsv
property.label: Type colors (Type|#hex, comma-separated)
property.description: Matched against Event.Type (case-insensitive). 'Other' is the fallback.

property.name: typesFilterCsv
property.label: Event types to keep (comma-separated, optional)
property.description: Whitelist of Event.Type values to show. Leave empty to include every type. Acts as a static filter - the in-UI toggles mute types on top of this.

property.name: hideTypeToggles
property.label: Hide clickable type toggles
property.description: Off by default - chips are shown. Turn on to hide the one-chip-per-Event.Type filter strip that lets the user mute/unmute each 'calendar' in the timeline.

property.name: hideNowLine
property.label: Hide the 'now' line
property.description: Off by default - the red line is shown.

property.name: hideJoinButton
property.label: Hide the auto-detected Join button
property.description: Off by default - scans Event Location and Description for a Zoom / Teams / Meet / WebEx URL and shows a Join button when found.

property.name: emptyStateMessage
property.label: Empty-state message (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default.
